div.div:
66 tables, all columns and constraints, scoped foreign keys, and operation contracts.
Pages 01-16: domain tables. Every FK is listed with exact column mapping and UML
multiplicity. Cross-page references name the target table; they are not missing
relationships.
CORE RELATIONS: simplified visual spine.
RULES: global invariants and enforcement layer.
ACTIVITIES: checkout, refund, admission, offline and durable delivery.
OPERATIONS: every transaction write set and failure behavior.
STATES: permitted transitions and guards.
Companion specification includes full data dictionary, relationship catalogue, indexes,
access rules and SQL enforcement boundary.

div.div:
<<table>> = physical relational table shown as UML class.
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UQ = unique key.
NN = NOT NULL; ? = nullable.
A child FK points to 1 or 0..1 parent.
A parent has 0..* children unless a unique FK limits it to 0..1.
No composition diamonds: deletes do NOT cascade.
DDL = enforced by supplied PostgreSQL schema.
TX = required atomic application transaction; not implemented by DDL alone.
APP = authorization, parsing, storage or provider code.
QUERY = read-model/query correctness.
All money is bigint minor units: 1 KZT = 100.
Times use timestamptz; event stores its named timezone.

div.div:
Refund approval first invalidates the original ticket and quarantines inventory. Commit
this BEFORE asking the provider for a refund.
Pending, uncertain or failed refunds do not make stock saleable. Only authoritative refund
success releases the allocation.
A later buyer receives a NEW allocation, order item and ticket. The old ticket and all
financial relations remain in history.

div.div:
This is a design baseline, not a claim that the application or migrations are deployed.
All requirements modules and bonuses are represented. Real-money operation and production
KYC remain excluded.
Proposed defaults such as recipient claiming, one-time attendee entry proof and offline
final admission remain labelled in the specification.
Offline operations are provisional. They become central admissions only after current-state
validation on reconnect.
